reviews.text: On a morning stroll around Rue-Notre Dame with our dog Milo, we were looking for a cafe to get some breakfast and came across Café Maison Pawz. The staff was very pleasant and friendly. They made us feel at home and Milo had a great time while we enjoyed our drinks and delicious sandwiches! Milo says merci for the treat :)
My 2 poodles can be very anxious but the groomers were calm and the look is perfect!

Hi Pascal,
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back soon.   Warmly,
--
Café Maison Pawz

It was Cookie’s first grooming experience, and we were so nervous because he’s only 5 months old. Angie took such special care of him, was very gentle and patient, and made him feel comfortable right away. He came out so happy, and his haircut was absolutely adorable! 🐶❤️

The place was clean and welcoming, and we loved being able to have coffee and watch Cookie through the window. Such a wonderful first experience — we’ll definitely be back! 🐾

Absolutely love Maison Pawz in Griffintown! Such a cute and unique concept, a cozy café and a grooming place for dogs all in one. Truly the best of both worlds! The atmosphere is welcoming, the coffee is pretty good, and it’s perfect for dog lovers.

Hi Shirley,
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We’re so glad to have you in the Café Maison Pawz family and can't wait to welcome you (and your pup!) back soon for another treat or pampering session.   Warmly,
The Café Maison Pawz Team

Super impressed with this place.
Friendly staff, great hours
Most important great attention and care for my dog

Honestly, I don't even know where to begin. I'm incredibly grateful for all the attention and care Ginger received. I'd had a really bad experience with another groomer before, so I was quite nervous about leaving her with someone new. Ginger had a lot of knots, but they were so patient, gentle, and caring with her.

I'm more than happy with the result and especially relieved to have found a place where I feel confident leaving Ginger. We will definitely be back!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Today I took my baby girl to Maison Pawz Inc. 🐾 and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! Ricardo was absolutely amazing with her, so gentle, patient, and caring. ❤️

The service was impeccable from start to finish. They really take the time to ask you exactly what you want and make sure your pup looks just the way you envisioned.

The price is very reasonable, the timing is accurate, the setting is lovely and cozy.
The whole experience was professional and welcoming.

I’m SO happy we finally found our groomer!!! 🥰🐾 I highly recommend Maison Pawz Inc. to anyone looking for a groomer whom they can truly trust with their fur baby.

Thank you, Ricardo! We’ll definitely be back! ❤️🐾

Great experience! The service was excellent and my dog looked amazing after her full grooming. I loved being able to sit with a coffee and watch her through the window. And the coffee was great too!  Highly recommend!

We were again very pleased with Ricardo"s work on our dog and the prompt and responsive service offered by the staff for an enjoyable experience. Our dog was in very good hands. Thanks again to Ricardo !

We’re so glad we found this place, we felt right at home from the moment we walked in! The owner and groomer were there to welcome us, and while our little Kaiko was getting his grooming, we enjoyed a coffee and sandwich chatting with the owner. We can’t recommend this place enough; our little Kaiko had a blast too! 😊 …

Thank you so much for your lovely review, Sarah! ⭐️ The whole team loved Brooklyn! 🐶
-- Cafe Maison Pawz …
Excellent service. The staff is kind, understanding, and attentive. Grooming completed to our liking.
I really like Café Maison Pawze for Billie's grooming. They take good care of her and she's always impeccable after her appointment.

Honestly, best haircut my dog has ever had! It was soo easy to book and appointment and I love that they had next day availabilities which is hard to find with dog groomers. Had a yummy sandwich and iced latte and did some work while waiting for my dog! 10/10 experience!!!!!!
